evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Running MARCH, a published framework unmodified over 80 condition-by-cell measurements on two code judging benchmarks, we find it declares both solutions equally good on 78 to 95% of comparisons, reaching 4.4% accuracy where the same model asked directly reaches 43.7%.

evidence.excerpt: We argue such methods require two things of their evidence: it must be independent of the answer under review, and it must differ between the two candidates being compared.
